entities.title: MCP server
entities.summary: A minimal Model Context Protocol server: newline-delimited JSON-RPC in and out, the four methods it answers, and a usage-log record for every tool call.
entities.purpose: Holds McpServer, the one adapter between an MCP client and the tools. It builds the tool set for a session's roots, answers initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call, turns a tool's text or ToolException into an MCP tool result, and times and logs each call.
boundaries: What each tool does is src/Tools/; the server only dispatches by name.
Whether the session runs on standard input and output (in process) or on a daemon connection is decided by src/Program.cs and src/Daemon/; the server only sees a reader and a writer.
